answer: Endpoint attestation binding requires each identity to prove a unique hardware key and live network endpoint; the registry suspends every identity vertex sharing an endpoint. Rejoining requires separate compute and address plus full revalidation fee, so clones cannot share the original’s address garden. Reuse collapses linked identities; per-identity provisioning cost exceeds marginal revenue, making cloning strictly negative-EV—an overlap rule, not a fable.
